- **Series title:** Candace Kirk Archive (Candace Owens investigation series)
- **Source used for analysis:** YouTube captions (yt-dlp-manual) cleaned with video context; full transcript provided
- **Transcript completeness status:** Full (56:32 duration); minor transcription ambiguities flagged
- **Existing Nodes Reused:** N-1 (Charlie Kirk), N-2 (Erica/Erika Kirk – preserved as Erika per transcript), N-3 (Candace Owens), N-22 (Tucker Carlson), N-41 (Governor Cox)

Episode 33 advances the "Operation Mocking-Plane" thread by presenting what the host frames as additional flight-tracking evidence against Egyptian military aircraft alleged to have been monitoring Erika Kirk between 2022 and September 2025. The principal evidentiary materials displayed are (1) an ADSB Exchange data view showing transponder activity for tail SUBND at the Duncan Aviation FBO in Provo on September 10, (2) a spreadsheet the host claims documents 68 (later 73) overlap instances between the two aircraft and Erika Kirk's documented locations, (3) four rental vehicle license plates allegedly tied to the "Egyptian" arrivals, and (4) a YouTube report by "Wolves and Finance" examining missing IRS Form 990 filings for three Turning Point USA-related entities.

The episode also contains a Steven Crowder clip the host characterizes as a manufactured interpretation, and a Rob McCoy pastoral clip framed by the host as a "pre-bunking" psychological operation. The episode's structural importance is that it escalates the investigative pressure on Turning Point USA financial filings, raises specific licensing-plate and rental-vehicle identification requests to the public, and directs sustained skepticism toward the absence of organizational acknowledgment of the aircraft.

The transcript contains numerous rhetorical and interpretive passages – including speculation about motives and references to foreign-state actors – that do not meet the artifact-anchored standard for inscription and have not been inscribed as claims.
